capabilities: add mpv links with timestamps for local video files
open videos in mpv at a saved timestamp
update timestamps automatically when a video is closed
relocalize moved video files using stored hash and size
manage, clean, sort, and navigate existing mpv links
extras: Installation is manual (unzip a release into the plugins folder); the hash-based relocalization feature is marked Experimental, and the README references a video demonstration.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link notes to positions in local video files and keep those timestamps current as you watch.

relations.evidence: You need to have already installed mpv.

summary: Video link plugin that adds buttons opening local videos in the mpv player at saved timestamps, which update as you watch.
